Photon Mono M7 Series Tech Specs

FAQs

What do the ①②③④⑤ annotations in the product details mean?

The numbered annotations on the product page correspond to the following explanations:
① The data was measured using Anycubic high speed resin and sourced from Anycubic lab.
② The data is the from Anycubic lab.
③ Millionth of a second.
④ When printing with a 0.05mm thickness in standard high-precision mode, the speed increase value may vary among different models.
⑤ Breakage and bottom dropout detection support a minimum area of 15*15mm.

What is the hottest temperature that the heater can heat the resin to? Is the temperature control adjustable?

It is adjustable.The default temperature is 25 centigrade, and can be set at 20-40 centigrade.

Can the auto fill unit be used while the cover is on?

Yes it can be used while the cover is on.

Do I need to buy high speed resin for the fast prints? Or this can print fast with the normal resin?

Photon Mono M7 Pro can support both High Speed Resin and Standard Resins. The print speed is different. Max Speed 130mm/hr, 0.1mm Layer With Standand Resin; Max Speed170mm/hr, 0.1mm Layer With High Speed Resin.

What hardware is required when using a printer to clean and cure printed parts?

To clean and cure printed parts using a printer, you will need Cleaning Kit and Wash & Cure Machine.

How about finding out what resins this machine can support and where to find the resin settings for this 3D printer?

For information on resin settings, please visit: Resin Settings for Anycubic 3D Printers.
